frozen_emp_d.rule: stable process fraction >= 0.80 under all 50 taxa x 6 declared processes

promotion_logic.consequence: Because EMP-D is irreversibly false before answer-check opening, overall fresh-v5 promotion cannot pass regardless of any later sealed predictive metrics.

queued_sealed_runs.interpretation_if_they_later_execute: supplementary sealed predictive characterization only; cannot rescue, reopen, or promote fresh v5

scientific_interpretation: The predeclared fresh-v5 feature availability problem was solved prospectively: 50/50 taxa passed the 46-layer complete-case gate.
However, under the frozen model-pool-only process-identification rules, stable sharp process states were rare (16/300) and the primary SDMR route was unavailable for 40/50 taxa.
Fresh v5 therefore fails empirical promotion at EMP-D before sealed answer-check information is needed.
boundary: This does not alter the prospective known-truth M5 pass.
This does not show that the six ecological processes are biologically absent.
Unavailable or unresolved process states are not biological negatives.
Any later sealed score is post-terminal characterization and not promotion evidence.
